record.description: Type of analytics whether its a load on website or the conversation analytics/metadata.

userID.description: The associated conversation id/user id with the.

ipAddress.description: The IP address of the user.

countryCode.description: The country code associated with the user's location.

langCode.description: The language code indicating the user's language.

platform.description: The platform or device used by the user.

origin.description: The channel origin of the message.

ts.description: Timestamp indicating when the analytic load occurred.

interactionsNum.description: The number of interactions made by the user. (messages from user only)

firstMessageTS.description: Timestamp of the first message sent by the user.

lastMessageTS.description: Timestamp of the last message sent by the user.
